newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Oerlikon's Balzers und Leybold profit up.
newsitem.headline: Oerlikon's Balzers und Leybold profit up.

text.p: Balzers und Leybold, a division of Swiss diversified industrial group Oerlikon-Buehrle, said profit in 1996 rose by 22 percent to 128 million Swiss francs.
Gross turnover was 1.452 billion francs, down from 1.495 billion in 1995. Orders received totalled 1.475 billion versus 1.585 billion.
The number of personnel fell to 6,297 from 6,525 in the reporting year, which was largely a result of sale of Balzers-Pfeiffer via a stock offering last year.
Despite continued weakness in the semiconductor market, for which no end is yet seen, "Balzers und Leybold remains realistically optimistic," the company said in a statement.

"The year 1996 has showed that big changes can occur in a short time in markets in which (the company) is active. But based on the current view, optimism remains that in 1997 as well, turnover and profits of Balzers und Leybold Group would continue to rise," it said.

Balzers und Leybold said that its main activities in vacuum and surface technology were favourable in 1996, and "wide-reaching changes" were taken in stride. The positive trend in the company continued.
Balzers und Leybold is based in Hanau, Germany. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
